correctness.rationale: Exact reflection transforms negative discrepancy into positive discrepancy. For attraction \(0<d<\lambda\), the sole upper-range constraint is \(hxd(1-d^2/\lambda^2)\le1\); its maximizing state has \(p=1,x=1-d\), giving A. For repulsion \(d>\lambda\), the sole lower-range constraint is \(h(1-x)d(d^2/\lambda^2-1)\le1\); monotonicity gives supremum B as \(x\to0^+,p=1\), with genuine negative outputs above the threshold. A has unique interior maximum by strict log-concavity and strictly increases in lambda, while B strictly decreases; exact rational endpoint inequalities prove one crossover. Unit-step/media cases and boundaries follow from these necessary and sufficient bounds. Complete standalone verifier passed 44,939 exact/sampled checks; numerical checks are not used to infer universality.
